Alex: main just flipped red immediately after the hotpatch merge (PR #6842). smoke-grpc and kvalloc integration failing.
devops-bot: ci/main pipeline failed on stage `smoke-tests` (container-exec): exit code 1. logs uploaded -> https://ci.example.com/3951239876
Maria: ack. any obvious error in the logs?
Alex: stack snippet shows `AllocError: KV allocator OOM at shard 4` then a gRPC timeout. small merge, but could be config drift.
Samir: pinging @Maria and @Alex — I can take a quick bisect. can someone re-run the matrix with `SKIP_SLOW=true` to isolate?
Alex: re-run kicked off: `ci rerun 3951239876 --matrix smoke --env SKIP_SLOW=true` (started)
CI Bot: rerun queued, expected ~8m. linked run: https://ci.example.com/run/3951240001
Maria: if rerun still fails, suggest bisecting the last 5 merges on main. also check the autoscaler annotations change in the hotpatch.
Samir: acknowledged. if rerun fails i'll start `git bisect start main^ main -- test=./scripts/run-smoke.sh` and report back minimal repro.
Alex: thanks. leaving logs and the failing command here:
```
./scripts/run-smoke.sh --target grpc-smoke
ERROR: gRPC call failed: deadline exceeded after 10s
KV_ALLOC: failed to reserve 12MB on shard 4
```
Samir: looks like a perf regression vs allocator metadata. i'll grab heap profiles from the failed run and update here in 10.
Maria: :thumbsup: if anyone else sees capacity spikes on staging, please drop them here. tagging oncall.
Alex: adding a note to the merge PR to pause additional merges until we triage.
Samir: quick update — rerun still red, bisect started. will post first suspect shortly.
